Whiscash

Water Ground

Hoenn · Generation 3

Whiscash is a Water/Ground-type Whiskers Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 23.6 kg. It evolves from Barboach. Its highest base stat is HP (110), with a base stat total of 468.
